title: Moss Mysteries
solvedCount: No case solved yet | 1 case solved | {count} cases solved
clueRevealed: A new clue is waiting in Moss Mysteries. | {count} new clues are waiting in Moss Mysteries.
intro: Someone has been found dead in a house full of guests. Each task you complete reveals one clue about where everyone stood. Work out the whole floor plan, then name the murderer.
off: Moss Mysteries is off, so completed tasks reveal no clues.

rules.title: How to play
rules.grid: Everyone stands on exactly one square, and no two people share a row or a column: each row and each column holds one person.
rules.murderer: The victim’s room holds exactly two people: the victim and the murderer. Nobody else is ever alone with the victim.
rules.furniture: Armchairs, sofas and beds are seats: someone can stand there. Every other piece of furniture fills its square, so nobody stands on it.
rules.directions: North is the top of the plan and west is its left. “Next to” means sharing a side, even through a wall into another room; touching at a corner does not count.
rules.counts: A room’s head count includes the victim: “Nobody was in the kitchen” means the victim was not there either, and “Exactly 3 people were in the library” counts the victim among them.
rules.clues: Each task you complete reveals the next clue.
rules.marks: Pick a person, then tap a square to place them. With nobody picked, tap an empty square to cross it out, or tap a placed person to take them back off. Your marks are saved with the case.
rules.accusation: Once everyone is placed, choose the murderer and accuse. A wrong accusation costs nothing and does not say what is wrong.
